text: Week 1 (Dawamom_Bemba_Fixed_Safe): Baby development — Umwana tatendeke ukupangika  Maternal changes — ifishibilo fyenu ifya ku mweshi: ukufuuta umulopa, ukukalipa amabeele, ukusuntinkana kwa mibele.  Tips — Kuli ukukabila kwa kwaluka kwa mibele ya mweo ukwacitwa ukulundako amashuko yenu aya kukwata umwana uwa mweo bwino mu nshila: Ukukansha kwa mubili Ifya kulya ifyalinga Ama vitamini aya pa ntanshi.  Calinga ukuleka ukubomfya ifintu fimo pamo ngefi .Caffein Artificial sweetenersUbwalwa Recreational drugs Nicotine  Plan — Ica kulya icalinga  Ukutendeka ukukansha umubili

Week 2 (Dawamom_Bemba_Fixed_Safe): Baby development — Umwana tatendeke ukukula  Maternal changes — Ovulation itendeka nga ilini ilili mature lyafuma muli ovary nokuya ikala mu Fallopian tube.  Ilini lilaikala ama awala 12-24 pa numa ya kufuma muli ovary.  Mu cituntulu, ilini fye limo lyafumikwa lyonse ilyo mulecita ovulte.  Ovulation (ukupanga amani) kuti kwalubana pamulandu wakusakamikwa, ukulwala, ukwenda, no kwaluka kwakulisha mu kufina, ukubomfya, no kulaala.  Tips — Icintu cacindama ico mwingacita pali ino nshita ni co mulecita mu nshila iyo mwingacita nga ca kuti mwalishibe kale ukuti muli ne fumo.  Apo kuti papita imilungu iingi ilyo taulaishiba nga ca kut ifumo lyaliingila , ici cikacingilila imwe no mwana wenu ku ntanshi ku fintu nelyo imilimo iili yonse iyo ingaleta amafya.  Plan — Ica kulya icalinga  Ukutendeka ukubomfya(exercising).

Week 3 (Dawamom_Bemba_Fixed_Safe): Baby development — Embryo (akaana) mu mubili wenu cili icinono nga nshi kabili mu cine cine cilemoneka nga ibumba lya maselo ukucila pa mwana.  Ni bukulu bwa mutwe wa pin kabili mupepi na 0.48 mm mu butali.  Blastocyst cilekula no kufula bwangu pali ino nshita. Pati ya blastocyst ya lasanguka (placenta) icisa cikakwata umulopa wa mu kati, uukapanga HCG ( Human .Chorionic gonadotropin) Iyi e homoni ya ifumo iyasangwa ukupitila mu kupima kwa fumo.  Amafuta ya (amniotic fluids) nayo yalelonganika ukushinguluka amaselo kabili yakacingilila umwana wenu mwi fumo yenu yonse.Imilimo yacindama iya kukula kwa mwana uuli mwi fumo yatendeka muli uyu mulungu, ukubikapo no kukula kwa bongobongo,umusana, umutima na mumala (Gastrointestinal tract)  Maternal changes — Banamayo abengi tabamona ukwaluka ukuli konse, lelo banamayi bamo balakwata ukufuuta kwa mutembo no kukulisha ukufumya kwa mu kati ukwa muputule wa ku nse ukushinguluka kwa( ovulation) .Banamayo bamo balakwata ukufuuta kwa mu fumo ukwacepa nelyo ukumona ukwayanguka ukwaishibikwa nga “ukufuma umulopa mu mubili.”  Ita dokota nga ca kuti ulefuma umulopa nga nshi nelyo nga uli no ubukali ubukalamba; ici kuti calanga ukuti ali ne fumo lya ku nse ya icisa uko embryo yabikwa pa nse ya icisa (ilingi line mu fallopian tube)  Tips — Umubili wenu watendeka ukupita mu kwaluka kwabipisha, kabili kuti mwaumfwa ukuti muli no kucula inshita shimo.  Shininkisheni ukuti tamusakamana ukupuupa ukwalinga no kuisakamana. Ukupanga inshita ya kutuusha no kusekelela muli ukufyala.  Ukusakamikwa e cintu icabipisha ku mubili wenu no mwana ilyo muli ne fumo, bomfyeni inshila sha kucingililamo amasakamiko yenu ayacepa.  *Calinga ukuleka ukubonya ifintu pamo ngefi* ubwalwa, illegal drugs, Imiti shimoshimo, ifyakulya fimofimo, caffeine, ukupepa fwaka.  Plan — Ukukansha umubili kwalicindama ilyo uli ne fumo. Landa naba shin'gnga bobe ilyo bashilatendeka ukubomba imilimo ya ku mubili.  Mu mibele iingi, nga ca kuti uli kale pa lwa kucincimusha umubili, kuti watwalilila ukuikala mu mikalile yobe.  Ukulya ifya kulya na kabili kwalicindama nga nshi muli uku kuimita.  ifyakulya ifya mweo ne fya kulya fimbi ifyacindama ne fya kulya fya ma vitamin fyakabilwa ukukula kwa mu fumo na follic acid.  Ukulya ifya kulya ifyalinga ne fipimo fyalinga ifya ku mubili na kabili kwalicindama kuli imwe no mwana.

Week 4 (Dawamom_Bemba_Fixed_Safe): Baby development — Abana bacili abanono nga nshi pali ino nshita kabili ukupima mupepi na mamilimita 1.98 mu butali.  Kuli ifiputulwa fitatu ku mwa wenu, ectoderm,mesoderm endoderm .ifi ifiputulwa fitatu fikapanga ifilundwa fya mwana.  Iciputulwa ca ectoderm cikaba ica mishipa nervous system( ukubikako na bongobongo) inkanda,imishishi, amalaa, mammary glands, sweat glands na ameno.  Mesoderm iciputulwa cabubili cikapanga umutima, umubili wamuntu na imishipa. Iciputulwa ca butatu cikakwata ifipuupu kabili cikakula mu chifuba ca mu malaa,liver,pancreas na thyroid.  Amaboko na mabuula yaku makasa yatendeka ukukula pali ino inshita nangu cakuti tayapusene bwino bwino.  Placenta nayo yatendeka ukupangika nakabili yatendeka uku panga ama homoni ayacindama ukubikapo na HCG.  Maternal changes — Kuti mwatendeka ukulanga ifishibilo fimo ifya kwimita bwangu pamo nga ukufuuta kwa ku mabele, uku kalipa kwa mutwe, kukalipwa kwa numa.  Calicindama ukwishiba ukuti ifishibilo ifingi ifya kwimita pakutendekelako fyapalana ne fyo mwingapitamo ilyo mili mukuya ku mweshi.  Banamayo bambi te kuti babe ne fishibilo fya ifumo maka maka nga ifumo linono.  Nga ca kuti mwalufya inshita yenu iya ku mweshi, lyena kuti mwapima ifumo.  Ici kuti caba ica kubalilapo ukuti waishiba ati lawimita.  Tips — Nga ca kuti tamutendeke ukubomfya ifya kucincimusha umubili, moneni kuli dokota wenu pa kuti mumone ifyo mwingapanda amano.  Vitamin yenu iya pa ntanshi ya mwana afwile ukukwata ukufika kuli 0.4 mg (micrograms 400) aya follic acid iya mu cifuba.  Ama vitamini aya pa ntanshi ilingi line yaba na 0.8 mg ukufika kuli 1 mg (amabumba 800 ukufika kuli 1milligram) aya follic acid kabili na kabili yalikwata iron iyingi.  Ifi fintu fyalicindama kuli imwe no mwana wenu.Na kabili mulefwaya ukucenjela pa lwa miti yalekanalekana iyo mwabomfeshe ilyo muli ne fumo.  Mufwile ukufwailisha kuli dokota wenu uwa kumusakamana ilyo tamulabomfya imiti iili yonse nelyo iya kulipilisha.  Plan — Nga ca kuti inshita yenu yalicelwa nelyo nga ca kuti muli ne nshita iyalinga, kuti mwafwaya ukufwailisha pa ng’anda.  Nga ca kuti icafumamo cisuma, kuti mwaesha ukupanga inshita ya kulanshanya na dokota wa fya bumi, nangu ca kuti abasakamana ubumi abengi balalolela ukumona imwe ukufikila mwaba ne milungu 8 ukufika 12.  Kabili mulefwaya ukutendeka umubomfi wa fya bumi no kupingulapo uko mukakwata umwana wenu.

Week 5 (Dawamom_Bemba_Fixed_Safe): Baby development — Umwana wenu acili umunono nga nshi, ukupima amamilimita 3 mu butali.  Pali ino nshita, ubutali bwa mwana wenu bwapimilwe ukufuma ku cilongwe ca mutwe ukufika ku mpela ya mpela ya ku numa (CRL).  Umutima wa mwana obe uleuma umusango wa nshita, kabili imipangile iyo ikasanguka amenso na matwi filepangwa.  Iciputulwa ca mwana uuli mwi fumo na co citendeka ukupanga.  Maternal changes — Ukupilibuka kwa mibele ya homoni mu mulungu walenga isano. Amasakamiko yenu yaka aluka ukufuma ku nsansa ukuya ku kukalipwa pa mulandu wa kukanaumfwa bwino.  Nga ca kuti ukulwala kwa kasuba kwabipisha nga nshi ica kuti lyonse mulepoosa no kukanasunga icili conse mumala, lanshanyeni na dokota wenu pa lwa maka ya kuba no bulwele bwa (hyperemesis gravidarum)kupopomenwa (ukucilapo ukukalipa no kupopomenwa mu nshita ya ifumo).  Tips — Kuti mwaipusha nga ca kuti mufwile ukufina ama kg yanga pe fumo.  Ba dokota Obstetricians na Gynecologists protocole balapanda amano ukuti umuntu ali no kufina kwa 11.3 ukufika kuli 15.9 amakilogalamu mu nshita ye fumo kuli banamayo ababa pa cipimo calinga ilyo ukufyala kwacitika.  Pa nshi ya kulema banamayo balingile ukukwata amakilogalamu mupepi na 15.4, lintu banamayo abafina sana balingile ukunonka ama 9 Kilograms.  Plan — Nga ca kuti na kabili tamwapekanya inshita ya kutandalila kwenu ukwa kubalilapo, ninshi mufwile ukuya ku ntanshi no kucita ifyo.  Nga ca kuti mucili mulelanshanya na badokota na ba midwives, kuti mwafwaya ukutendeka ukucicefyako pa kuti musale umupeela wenu.

Week 6 (Dawamom_Bemba_Fixed_Safe): Baby development — Umwana wenu ali mupepi na mamilimita 19.05 mu butali.  Ukutunguluka kwa mapapa, insekete, impumi, no mona fyatendeke. Amabolu na mafuti ya maboko yakwata ifikuulwa ifyapala iminwe ne fikondo, Bongobongo aletwalilila ukupanga mu fiputulwa fya iko ifyafina.  Ultrasound wa mu vaginal kuti yakwata amaka ya kwishiba ukubebeta kwa mutima ukwaumfwika pali ino nshita.  Maternal changes — Banamayo bamo abaimite kuti bamona ukuti balipokelele amapaundi ayanono pali ici cishinka, lintu bambi kuti bacefyako umubili.  Kuti mwatendeka ukumona ukwaluka mu mabele yenu ukusanshako ukufuuta, ukufiita kwa fipindami, no kufimba.  Na kabili kuti mwatendeka ukumfwa ubukali bwa mutima, icintu cimo icabako ilyo muli ne fumo.Uku kumona (ukutona kwa mulopa pa fya kufwala fya mu kati nelyo ipepala lya cimbusu pa numa ya kubomfya icimbusu) kuti fyakonkana no kukalipa kwa mumala.  Ici te mulandu wa kusakamana. Lelo, mukafwaya ukulolesha ukutona kwamulopa, lelo dokota wenu afyile aishiba pali ici.. Na kabili kuti mwafwaya ukulanshanya na dokota nga ca kuti umulopa ulafuma nga inshita ya kumweshi .Ici kuti caba cishibilo ca kuposa ifumo.  Tips — Banamayo bamo balailishanya ukuti aba vitamini yabo yalabalenga ukulwala. Nga ca kutila mwapita muli ici, kuti mwafwaya ukunwa ne fya kulya nelyo ubushiku ilyo tamulalala.Nga ca kuti mwatwalilila ukukwata amafya na amavitamini yenu , lanshanyeni no dokuta wenu ilyo tamulafileka fyonse.  Plan — Ukuishiba umusango wa mulopa obe no mulopa wa munyina mobe kwalicindama ilyo uli ne fumo.Umulopa wa muntu umo umo uwa misango ine iyakulisha . Type A, Type B, Type AB, Type O.  Calicindama ukwishiba umusango wa mulopa wenu pantu amafya kuti yacitika nga ca kuti nyina ali Rhneg kabili umwana ali bwino Rh-uwalinga.

Week 7 (Dawamom_Bemba_Fixed_Safe): Baby development — Umwana wenu ali mupepi na masentimita 2.54 mu butali ukufika ku mpela ya uno mulungu kabili alepele ukucila pa cipimo.  Pali ino nshita, cila cilundwa cacindama catendeke ukupanga mu mubili uunono uwa nyukiliya.  Inkanda ne nkanda filepangwa, kabili ifipe fya ku menso no lulimi fyatendeke ukukula.  Amaboko ne fipimo fya ku makasa ilyo umushipa watendeka ukulungika.  Maternal changes — Ilyo muli ne fumo, umubili wenu ukakwata ukwaluka panono panono.  Tacayanguka ukuti abantu abamushinguluka kuti baishiba no kuti muli ne fumo pali ino nshita.  Kuti mwasanga ama paundi yakwelelako, lelo na kabili kuti mwacefyako umubili nga ca kuti mulekwata ubulwele bwa lucelo.  Ukucefyako umubili pakubalilapo te bwabipa, kabili mu milungu iinono, ifintu fikatendeka ukupilibuka ku lubali lumbi.  Na kabili kuti mwakwata ifishibilo fimbi ifya kwimita.  Tips — Ukulya ifya kulya ifinono ilingi line.  Ukulya ifya kulya fya soda nelyo ifya kulya ifya pa maminiti 15 ilyo tamulabuuka mu nshita ya kasuba.  Pokeni ifya kulya ifingi, kabili mulelala akasuba .  Amalemoni nelyo umufuba,ulapwishako ukupopomenwa.  Ukutafuna kwa Ginger kuti kwaafwilisha mu pwishako ukupopomenwa.  Ukulya ifya kulya fya mucele.  Mwilakana ifya kulya nelyo ukulala pa numa ya kulya.  Mwipika nelyo ukulya ifya kulya fya nse (spicy) .  Mubomfye Vitamini B6 (50mg) cila bushiku.  Ipushe dokota pa lwa fya kunwa ifingafwa ukucefyako ukulwala kwa ulucelo.  Plan — Nga ca kuti tamwasalile dokota nelyo umubomfi wa bumi pali ino nshita, ni nshita ya kusalapo imo.

Week 8 (Dawamom_Bemba_Fixed_Safe): Baby development — Ici cimenwa calicila panono ukucila pa masentimita 2.54 kabili cili mupepi no bukulu bwa bean.  Ifintu fyonse ifyaba mu muntu umukalamba nomba fyaba mu mwana wenu. Amatwi yaletwalilila ukupanga pa nse na mu kati.  Amafupa yatendeka ukukula, kabili imisipa kuti yasela. Iminwe ne fikondo ku makasa filekula inshita itali.  Ifintu fya ku cinso fya mwana wenu fyalitwalilila ukukula. Iciputulwa ca ku mpumi cilipo, kabili ifipimo fya menso nomba fyalikula sana.  Umucila wa mwana uuli mwi fumo na o ulepwa, kabili umubili wa mwana obe uletendeka ukulungika.  Nangu ca kuti gender wa mwana wenu walishininkishiwa kale, ifipe fya ku nse ficili filepangwa kabili te kuti fimoneke bwino bwino.  Maternal changes — Nangu ca kutila te kuti cimoneke kwati umubili wenu walipilibuka ukufuma ku nse, ukwaluka ukwafulilako kwacitike mu mubili obe onse.  Ilyo tamulakwata imita, icisa cenu cali mupepi no bukulu bwa cisa cenu, lelo nomba cili mupepi no bukulu bwa fisabo fya muolife.  Kuti mwamona ukwaluka mu mabele yenu na kabili. Kuti bacilapo ukutemwa kabili kuti baumfwa bwino.  Ici caliba fye bwino nga fintu umubili wenu ulepekanya ukukalipwa.  Ukupilibuka kumbi ukwacitike ukuti te kuti mwishibe ni co umusango wa mulopa wenu walikulilako pa ma peresenti 40 ukufika kuli 50.  Tips — Mu nshita ya ifumo, banamayo bamo balakwata inkanda iya mafuta kabili balacula ku nkanda nama pimple.  Nga mulebomfya imiti yamu ma famasi ku kundapa ici, calicindama ukuti mwishibe ifya kusankanyamo ifyo ifipe fikwata.  Nga ca kuti muli na mepusho pa lwa kucingililwa kwa miti imo ilyo muli ne fumo, kuti cawama ukulanshanya na umubomfi wa fya miti.  Plan — Kuti mwaya mu kutandalila kwenu ukwa kubalilapo ukwa mwana ilyo tamulafyala, nangu kuti papita imilungu ibili ukufuma apo mwafumine.(Ukutandalila kwa kubalilapo ilingi line kuli pa kati ka milungu 8 na 12 ukufuma pa nshita yenu iya kulekelesha iya ku mweshi.) Dokota wenu akalomba ilyashi lya kale ilya fya miti olo ifyakulwala nge ifi: Birth control methods, History of abortions andor miscarriages, Hospitalizations, Medications you are taking and medication allergies, Your family’s medical history.  Ifyakumipima kuchipatala ifyapala Pap Smear, cervical cultures na ultrasound• futi enshita mwingepusha amepusho yonse eyo mukwete.

Week 9 (Dawamom_Bemba_Fixed_Safe): Baby development — Umwana wenu ali mupepi no bukulu bwa muolife, ukupima amasentimita 4.24 ukufuma ku mutwe ukufika ku rump wakwe, kabili alepima iciputulwa ca ounce.  Umwana wenu atendeka ukumoneka nga muntu umunono ukufuma pa mucindo wa mwana uwa mu mufuko uwapwa mu mulungu 9. Ifibumba fya menso fyapangwa bwino bwino, fyalikanikwa, kabili fikafunguluka na kabili mu mulungu wa 28. Umubili wa mwana yonse, ukusanshako ne elbow, joint,knee, shoulder na wrist joints filebomba.  Umutima wa mwana wenu watendeke ukupema ubushiku bwa 24. Nomba umutima walipaatukana mu fipindami fine, kabili amavalvu yatendeke ukukula.  Umwana wenu kuti apanga icibokoshi kabili kuti atendeka ukufyompa umunwe wakwe.  Maternal changes — Ne lyo line te kuti mumonekele ku bantu bambi ati muli nefumo, lelo mu kushininkisha mwatendeka ukumona ukwaluka ukwafulilako.  Kuti mwaumfwa ukupilibuka kwa mibele, ukukalipa kwa mutima, no kumfwa ukucilapo ukufiita.  Kuti mwacingilila ku kulya ifya kulya ifinono ubushiku bonse ukucila ukulya ifya kulya fitatu ifikulu.  Na kabili kuti mwacingilila ukukalipwa kwa mutima tekwesha ukulala pa numa ya kulya no kucingililwa ku fya kulya ifya nse (spicy) nelyo ifya mafuta.  Tips — Pali iyi nshita mu kwimita kwenu, kuti mwatendeka ukumfwa ukunaka ukucilapo.  Ici kuti caletwa no kwaluka kwa ma homoni, amafya ya kulaala ubushiku, nelyo ukulwala kwa mu ulucelo(morning sickness).  Ukukanalala bwino ubushiku kuti kwaba pa mulandu wa kukanakwata amaka ya kusanga icifulo icisuma nelyo ukufuma ku lwendo lwa taputapu ukuya ku cimbusu.  Nga ca kuti uli no bwafya bwa kulaala, kuti wafwaya ukutontonkanya pa kwalula ififulo fyobe ifya kulala.  Plan — Nga ca kuti uli ne myaka ukucila pali 35 nelyo uli ne lyashi lya lupwa ilya bulwele bwa cifyalilwa pamo nga ubulwele bwa ku nsengo, lyena kuti wafwaya ukutontonkanya pa kumona umupandamano wa fya kufyalwa(genetic counselor) .  Landeni na dokota wenu pa lwa referral ukutuma nelyo ukukabila kwa kucita test ya chorionic villus sampling(CVS).

Week 10 (Dawamom_Bemba_Fixed_Safe): Baby development — Umwana wenu alicila pa 2 inches (amasentimita 5.08 mu butali, mupepi no bukulu bwa lime, kabili amabimbi mupepi ne ciputulwa ca nshita (amagramu 7).  Iyi e mpela ya nshita ya kufyala no kutendeka kwa nshita ya mwana ilyo ifilundwa fya mwana wenu fyatwalilila ukukula no kukula.  Iciputulwa cikalamba ica fipindami fya mwana wenu (ukubikako ne mfyo, liver,kidney, bongobongo na ama lungs) filebomba lelo fikatwalilila ukukula mu nshita yonse iya ifumo yenu iyashala.  Umutwe wa mwana wenu uli no butali bwa mubili, kabili kuli ukubutuka mu mpumi ukusuminisha ukukula kwa bongobongo.  Iminwe tayaba iyalepa. Umwana ali no kumina amenshi ya ku mubili (amniotic fluids )no kupanta amakasa yakwe.  Maternal changes — Icisa(uterus) cenu calitwalilila ukukula, lelo mucili mulelanga ifingi pali ino nshita.  Banamayo bamo kuti baba abaiteyanya ukushimikilako bambi pa lyashi, lintu bambi kuti bacili baleipekanya ku cishinka ca kuti bali ne fumo.  Calicindama ukuba uwaisuka pa lwa mimwene yenu no mwinamwenu na kuli dokota wenu.  Tips — Nangu ca kuti uli ne fumo, kuli imilimo yalekanalekana iyo wingasangwako ku kwikala mu musango uwamweo.  Nangu ca kuti wali uwacincila ilyo ushila imita nelyo iyo, lanshanyeni na dokota bobe pa lwa misango ya milimo iyalinga kuli iwe.  Ba dokota abengi balapanda amano ukwenda no kusamba pantu balabomba bwino nga nshi ifyo bengabomfya mu nshita yonse iya ifumo .  Plan — Ukutandalila kwenu ukwa bubili ukwa pa ntanshi ya kufyala kukacitika pa kati ka milungu 12 na 16. Mu nshita ya kutandalila, dokota wenu kuti acita umulimo wa kumusuminisha ukumona umwana wenu pa muku wa kubalilapo.  Dokota wenu kuti abomfya umuti wa ku Doppler stethoscope pa kuti amone ukuti umwana wenu alipema fye bwino.

Week 11 (Dawamom_Bemba_Fixed_Safe): Baby development — Umwana wenu alicila pali 2 1⁄2 inches(amasentimita 6.35 )ayalepa ukufuma ku cilongwe ukufika ku rump (CRL) kabili ukupima iciputulwa ca nshita (amagramu 14.17)  Umutwe wa mwana obe ulelondolola mupepi na hafu wa butali bwa mutwe wakwe.  Iminwe yonse ibili yalipaatukena mu mulungu walenga 11. Inkanda ya mwana icili transparent, kabili amafupa yaletendeka ukukosa.  Iciputulwa ca ku nse ica kufyalilamo mupepi no kupangwa fyonse, kabili mu milungu iingi kuti mwaishiba nga ca kuti muli no mulumendo nelyo umukashana.  Kabili, nangu ca kuti te kuti muumfwe umwana wenu ale-enda, umwana wenu alibomba nga nshi(active) .  Maternal changes — Nangu ca kuti umwana wenu alekula bwangu bwangu mu kati ca icisa cenu, ukwaluka kwaishibikwa mu kumoneka kwenu ukwa ku mubili kuti kwacepa.  Lelo, banamayo bamo bamba ukwaluka mu nkanda shabo, mu fipimo fya ku makasa, na ku makasa, pamo nga ukufulilako kwa mishishi.  Ifi fimonwa nga fyalinga ilyo umuntu ali ne fumo. Ba dokota tabashininkishe bwino bwino umulandu ici cicitika lelo basumina ukuti ni pa mulandu wa kuti ukufulilako kwa ma homoni.  Tips — Banamayo abengi abaimite balikwata ifipusho ifingi pa lwa lwendo ilyo bali ne fumo.  Nga ca kuti tapali amafya ya kwimita ayaishibikwa nelyo ukusakamikwa pa lwa ifumo yenu, caliba icacingililwa ukupita inshita shonse ilyo muleyenda.  Inshita isuma iya kutandalila ilyo umuntu ali ne fumo ni mu nshita ya bubili iya mweshi.  Ici ni pa mulandu wa kuti mu milandu iingi mwapita mu bulwele bwa ku lucelo (morningsickness) ukufuma ku mweshi wa kubalilapo, kabili ni pa ntanshi ya fiputulwa fya ku numa ifya ifumo ilyo cilaba icakosa ukupitana.  Plan — Nga ca kuti wali no kucula ku bulwele bwa lucelo (morningsickness) muli iyi milungu iingi iya kubalilapo iya ifumo, kuti limbi wacefyako umubili .  Takuli ukusakamikwa kwakabilwa; banamayo abengi balapokelela fye ama paundi 3 ukufika kuli 4 (1.3 ukufika kuli 1.8 amakilogalamu) mu nshita ya kubalilapo.  Fwayeni ifingi pa lwa kufina pa kusambilila ifyo mufwile ukusanga.

Week 12 (Dawamom_Bemba_Fixed_Safe): Baby development — Umwana wenu ali 3.15 inches (amasentimita 8) mu butali kabili alema 1 ounce (mupepi na ma gram 28) pa mpela ya uno mulungu . Ngatapantile imiku ikumi limo panuma yaba hawa babili, lolelenikopanono elyo mutampe nakabili. Ngatamumfwile ifili fyonse, ebeni dokota wenu. Ama bra ya kukusha umwana yalaafwa sana no mwana wenu ilyo ashilafyalwa abafyalwa.  Kuti baifwala na mu nshita ya kasuba nga ca kuti baleumfwa bwino. Abanakashi bamo nabo bafwaya ukushininkisha ukuti ifintu fyaba bwino ukuwamya ing'anda nangu icikuulwa.  Kuti cawama ukukwata ifya kulya ifya kubomfya pa ng'anda pa kuti mwingaipekanishishako icakulya ca bushiku bumo balilombele.  Plan — Mufwile ukulapwisha amasambililo ya kupekanya ukufyalwa kwa mwana no kupekanya ifintu fimbi pa kuti umwana afyalwe. Maternal changes — The top of your uterus is now at the same level as your belly button.  You may have gained around 8 to 10 pounds by this point.  Also common during this time are leg cramps, swelling in the hands and feet, dry eyes, varicose veins, and trouble sleeping.  Tips — It is vitally important to make sure that you get enough nutrients in your diet, especially iron.  An increase in iron intake is necessary as it assists in the production of hemoglobin and prevents anemia, low birth weight, and premature delivery.  Good sources of iron include lean red meat, pork, dried beans, and spinach.  Plan — It is time to begin thinking about the delivery of your baby.  You will want to spend some time thinking through your hopes and wishes for this special day.  Creating a birth plan can help you communicate your desires clearly with all the people who will provide support to you.

Week 21 (Dawamom_English_Dataset_Fixed): Baby development — Up until this point, your baby's length was measured from the crown to the rump (CRL), but now it is measured from crown to heel (CHL).  Your baby's eyelids have finished forming this week.  The digestive tract is continuing to mature as your baby swallows amniotic fluid.  If your baby is a girl, her vagina has fully formed.  Maternal changes — If you place your fingers about a half-inch above your belly button, you may be able to feel your uterus.  If you notice that your lower legs and feet swell towards the end of the day, try to schedule a couple of times a day when you can sit and rest.  Round ligament pain tends to increase as Baby grows, and you may feel shortness of breath.  Tips — A urinary tract infection (UTI) is more common during pregnancy because of changes in the urinary tract.  You can reduce the likelihood of developing a UTI by drinking 6-8 glasses of water each day, wiping from front to back, and urinating before and after intercourse.  Plan — As you gain more weight, you may notice that you are beginning to develop varicose veins, which occur in the majority of pregnant women.  They most often appear in the legs but can also be found in the vulva and rectum.

Week 22 (Dawamom_English_Dataset_Fixed): Baby development — Your baby looks like a newborn but much smaller.  Your baby's skin appears wrinkly because your baby has not yet gained enough weight to fill the skin out.  The eyes have completely formed, but the iris still lacks pigment.  The eyelids and eyebrows are in place, and the pancreas is continuing to mature.  Maternal changes — You can now feel the top of your uterus about ¾ of an inch (2 cm) above your belly button.  Pregnancy often causes thick and shiny hair and fast-growing nails.  You might also get dry, irritated skin on your stomach, since it's constantly stretching.  Tips — Many women begin worrying about preterm labor.  A Fetal fibronectin (fFN) test can be done to determine the risk.  If this protein is found in vaginal secretions between 22 and 38 weeks, there is an increased risk of preterm labor.  Plan — If you have not already arranged childbirth education classes, it is time to do so.  Try to complete your class by the end of your 37th week, to ensure you can finish it before labor begins.

Week 23 (Dawamom_English_Dataset_Fixed): Baby development — Lanugo, or the fine hair that covers your baby's body, may darken at this point, allowing it to be seen on an ultrasound.  Your baby is also looking more like a newborn.  Maternal changes — Your uterus now extends about 1½ inches (3.8 cm) above your belly button, and your weight gain should be around 12 to 15 pounds (5.4 to 6.8 kg).  Your uterus is sitting directly on top of your bladder, which can cause you to leak fluid.  If you notice fluid leaking that is odorless, it may be amniotic fluid; call your healthcare provider immediately.  Tips — Drinking plenty of fluids, especially water, is extremely important during pregnancy.  If you are drinking enough water, your urine should be pale yellow or even clear.  Drinking enough water can help prevent headaches, uterine cramping, and swelling.  Plan — If you are currently working, you should be finalizing the plans and paperwork for your maternity leave.  It is best to go ahead and begin discussing with your partner whether you plan to return to work and who will care for the baby.

Week 24 (Dawamom_English_Dataset_Fixed): Baby development — Your baby's brain is growing rapidly at this time.  Taste buds are also forming, and the lungs are becoming more developed and complex.  Special cells are producing surfactant, which is necessary for the air sacs to inflate easily.  Maternal changes — You can now feel the top of your uterus around 2 inches (5 cm) from your belly button.  The skin on your abdomen and breasts is stretching, which can cause these areas to feel itchy.  Your eyes may also feel more sensitive and dry.  Tips — If you are having a problem with heartburn, you may want to try eating smaller meals throughout the day.  Many women find that eating five or six small meals a day decreases the amount of heartburn they experience.  Plan — Between 24 and 28 weeks, most healthcare providers will perform a glucose screening test to check for gestational diabetes.  Gestational diabetes is a temporary form of diabetes in which the body does not produce adequate amounts of insulin to regulate sugar levels during pregnancy.

Week 25 (Dawamom_English_Dataset_Fixed): Baby development — Your baby is slowly gaining some baby fat, which will help your baby appear less wrinkled.  If your baby has hair, the color and texture could be seen at this point.  Your baby's gender can be determined by an ultrasound.  Maternal changes — Your uterus is approximately the size of a soccer ball.  You may be suffering from carpal tunnel syndrome, which happens from swelling and fluid retention and causes a tingly, numb sensation in your hands.  Tips — Whether or not you know the gender of your baby, you may want to begin thinking about baby names.  Ask yourself what the initials spell out and if there are any nicknames associated with the name.  Plan — You may be tempted to have a keepsake ultrasound performed, but there are health concerns.  An ultrasound should be requested by a physician for a medical reason and performed by trained professionals.

Week 26 (Dawamom_English_Dataset_Fixed): Baby development — The nerves in the ears are developing, allowing your baby to respond more consistently to sounds.  Your baby is continuing to swallow amniotic fluid which is fostering lung development.  If you are having a little boy, his testicles have begun their descent into his scrotum.  Maternal changes — The top of your uterus can now be felt about 2½ inches (6.3 cm) above your belly button.  Your weight gain should be between 16 and 22 pounds (7.25 to 10 kg).  Intense itching in your hands and feet could signal a liver disorder called cholestasis of pregnancy and needs medical care.  Tips — The FDA recommends eating 8 to 12 ounces of fish low in mercury per week.  Four types of fish should not be eaten while pregnant: tilefish from the Gulf of Mexico, shark, king mackerel, and swordfish.  Plan — During your next prenatal appointment you should be prepared for various blood screenings, an antibody screen for Rh negative, and a glucose tolerance test for diagnosing gestational diabetes.

Week 27 (Dawamom_English_Dataset_Fixed): Baby development — Around the 27th to 28th week, babies can open and close their eyes.  Your baby has also developed a regular wake and sleep cycle.  You may also begin to feel rhythmic movements, which are likely hiccups.  This is completely normal as your baby's lungs continue to mature.  Maternal changes — By this point in your pregnancy, you can feel your baby move much more.  Many women ask questions concerning how often they should feel their baby move.  Later in pregnancy, you may be asked to determine your baby's kick count.  Some women get hemorrhoids during the second trimester due to increased blood flow.  Tips — If you have a car, we recommend you get an infant car seat.  Talk with other moms and/or a pediatrician to find out what products they recommend.  Also, make sure that the car seat fits in your car and is installed properly.  Plan — If you have not made arrangements for childbirth classes, now is the time.  Remember that you want to have them completed by the time you have finished 37 weeks.

Week 28 (Dawamom_English_Dataset_Fixed): Baby development — Your baby's brain is beginning to develop grooves along its surface.  The amount of brain tissue also begins to increase during the 28th week.  Eyebrows and eyelashes are visible, while the hair on your baby's head grows even longer.  Fat storage under the skin continues to develop.  Maternal changes — The top of your uterus can now be felt well above your belly button, about 3 ½ inches (8.9 cm) or more.  Your weight gain is most likely between 17 and 24 pounds (7.7 to 10.8 kg).  Many women will begin experiencing leg cramps, constipation, insomnia, and hemorrhoids at this point.  Tips — You need to begin making plans for the trip to the hospital.  Make sure you have your partner's phone number(s) with you at all times.  Additionally, you will want to map out the various routes to your birthing location.  Plan — You will likely begin visiting your health care provider every 2 weeks until you reach 36 weeks.  After 36 weeks, your appointments will be scheduled on a weekly basis.  You may be given Rhogam if you have the Rh Factor.

Week 29 (Dawamom_English_Dataset_Fixed): Baby development — Your baby is rapidly growing at this point.  His/her head is also growing due to rapid brain development that began in week 28.  Muscles and lungs are also continuing to mature.  Maternal changes — Your total pregnancy weight gain at this point should be between 19 and 25 pounds (8.6 to 11.3 kg).  The top of your uterus can be felt somewhere between 3½ to 4 inches (8.9 to 10 cm) above your belly button.  Constipation is common during pregnancy.  As your body prepares for breastfeeding, you might notice yellowish colostrum leaking from your breasts.  Tips — The Dawa community healthcare worker helps the mother have a positive and safe birth experience.  They offer constant visits and in-person contact.  Plan — To prevent constipation, eat a high fiber diet including fruits, vegetables, and whole-grain bread.  Drink 10 to 12 cups of fluids each day  and exercise routinely.

Week 30 (Dawamom_English_Dataset_Fixed): Baby development — Your baby's eyes are becoming more mature, and your baby can now tell the difference between light and dark.  Babies at 30 weeks can even follow a light source with their eyes.  After birth, newborns only have the ability to focus on objects a few inches from their faces.  Maternal changes — You may begin noticing that you become tired more easily during this last part of pregnancy.  Additionally, your body is producing a number of hormones that can cause your joints to become looser.  This may result in your feet actually getting larger, which is normally a permanent change.  Tips — Many women during this stage of pregnancy report an increasing number of backaches.  This is related to weight gain and the baby's growth.  Proper posture can alleviate the back pain you are experiencing.  Plan — Now is the time to begin thinking about the different kinds of pain relief options that will be available to you when you deliver.  Options include natural childbirth, local anesthesia (like an epidural or spinal block), narcotics, and patterned breathing.

Week 31 (Dawamom_English_Dataset_Fixed): Baby development — Your baby is continuing to develop a layer of fat under the skin.  This gives your baby more of a newborn appearance.  During the next several weeks, your baby will begin to put on even more weight.  Maternal changes — You may have noticed a yellowish or creamy substance that has begun to leak from your breasts called colostrum.  Many women begin to experience Braxton Hicks contractions, which are 'practice contractions' where the muscles of your uterus tighten for approximately 30 to 60 seconds.  Tips — Hemorrhoids are not uncommon during pregnancy.  They are varicose (swollen) veins of the rectum and are usually painful.  You can treat them by taking warm baths with baking soda or using witch hazel to reduce swelling.  Plan — Have you decided if you are going to breastfeed or bottle feed?  Doing research on your options will help you make the best decision for your baby's health.  Another decision is whether to store your baby's cord blood.

Week 32 (Dawamom_English_Dataset_Fixed): Baby development — The toenails and fingernails have formed, and the lungs are continuing to mature, although they will not be fully developed for several more weeks.  Your baby's skeleton has completely formed, but the bones are still very soft and pliable.  Maternal changes — The top of your uterus can now be measured about 5 inches above your belly button.  Because the top of your uterus is so high, you may begin to have trouble breathing or feel short of breath.  This is due to the pressure that your growing uterus is placing on your diaphragm.  Your blood volume has increased by 40% to 50% during the past 32 weeks.  Tips — If you are experiencing Braxton Hicks contractions, there are several ways you can try to alleviate them: change positions, take a warm bath for 30 minutes or less, and drink a couple of glasses of water.  Plan — Around this time, your healthcare provider will ask you to begin making visits every two weeks.  You should also decide if you plan to save your baby's cord blood, which remains in the umbilical cord and placenta following birth.

Week 33 (Dawamom_English_Dataset_Fixed): Baby development — Your baby's skin is beginning to look less red and wrinkled.  Fat stores are continuing to be deposited under the skin.  The bones are all beginning to harden except for the skull, because the skull needs to remain soft and pliable for delivery.  Maternal changes — The top of your uterus is a little over 5 inches (12.7 cm) from your belly button.  Your total weight gain should be between 22 and 28 pounds (10 to 12.7 kg).  You may wonder if you will be able to tell when your water breaks.  Only 1 in 10 women experience a dramatic gush of amniotic fluid.  If you think your membranes are leaking, call your health care provider.  Tips — Many women may wonder if it is still safe to have sexual intercourse at this point in their pregnancy.  It is safe as long as your health care provider has not told you differently.  Plan — Your next prenatal appointment is a good time to discuss an episiotomy with your doctor.  An episiotomy is a surgical incision occasionally necessary to enlarge the vaginal opening.  Preventative measures include good nutrition, Kegels, and perineum massage techniques.

Week 34 (Dawamom_English_Dataset_Fixed): Baby development — Fat stores will help your baby regulate her body temperature after delivery.  The central nervous system is continuing to mature, and the lungs are well-developed.  Your baby has a good chance of surviving outside of the womb at this time.  Maternal changes — The top of your uterus can now be felt approximately 5½ inches (14 cm) above your belly button.  The amount of the amniotic fluid typically peaks between 34 and 36 weeks.  You may have noticed that your belly button has become an 'outie' or that it is extremely sensitive.  Tips — One of the best ways to avoid an episiotomy is by massaging the perineum.  Most health care providers recommend beginning this at 34 weeks.  Plan — Around this time many health care providers begin discussing a Group B Strep test, pain management options, and Cesarean birth (if needed).

Week 35 (Dawamom_English_Dataset_Fixed): Baby development — The vast majority of your baby's growth is complete by 35 weeks.  Your baby's kidneys are completely developed, and the liver is beginning to process waste.  Because your baby has grown so much, you may notice a change in her movements as there is less room to move around.  Maternal changes — There are about 6 inches (15.2 cm) from your belly button to the top of your uterus.  You should have gained anywhere from 24 to 29 pounds (10.9 to 13.2 kg).  Your baby will settle deeper into your pelvis in a process known as lightening, which will relieve pressure on your diaphragm but increase pressure on your bladder.  Tips — With the birth of your baby only a few weeks away, you need to begin finding a pediatrician.  Talk with your OB/GYN, midwife, family, and friends to see if they have any recommendations.  Plan — Between 35 and 36 weeks your health care provider will most likely want to begin seeing you once a week until you deliver.  Your doctor may also ask you to begin counting your baby's movements.  The recommendation is that you time how long it takes you to feel 10 kicks, flutters, swishes, or rolls.

Week 36 (Dawamom_English_Dataset_Fixed): Baby development — The fine downy hair (lanugo) that has covered your baby's skin is beginning to disappear, along with the vernix caseosa.  Your baby should be in the head-down position.  Maternal changes — Your baby is continuing to put on weight (about an ounce a day), but you will most likely not notice a change in your own weight.  You may notice an increase in the amount of Braxton Hicks contractions you experience.  About two to four weeks before delivery, your baby will begin 'dropping' into your lower pelvis.  Tips — If your breasts make you uncomfortable during the night, you may want to begin sleeping in a nursing bra.  Nursing bras provide much-needed support even before your baby is born.  Plan — You should pack your essentials for the hospital.  For the baby, you'll need an infant car seat, a going-home outfit, and newborn diapers.  For yourself, bring your health insurance card, breast pads, a comfortable going-home outfit, and sanitary pads.

Week 37 (Dawamom_English_Dataset_Fixed): Baby development — Even though your baby is considered full-term after this week, it is still better in most situations for the baby to remain in the womb until ready.  If your baby is not in the head-down position, you should talk with your health care provider and partner regarding the various options that are available.  Maternal changes — Your total weight gain should be around 25 to 35 pounds (11.3 to 15.9 kg).  As your body begins to prepare for labor, your cervix will begin to dilate and efface.  You will also pass the mucus plug, which blocked the opening of the cervix.  Labor could be hours, days, or even weeks away.  Tips — You are in a waiting game from this point on.  If there are any last-minute preparations that need to be completed before the arrival of your baby, now is a good time to finish these up.  You could prepare several meals that can be frozen and eaten once you and the baby are back at home.  Plan — You should be finishing up childbirth classes and taking care of any other preparations for your baby.  Make sure your bags are packed, and you may want to practice driving to the hospital.

Week 38 (Dawamom_English_Dataset_Fixed): Baby development — The vast majority of the organs are mature and fully functioning.  The only exceptions are your baby's brain and lungs. These two organs can function outside of the womb at this point, although they will continue to mature during childhood.  Maternal changes — You may experience some swelling in your feet, which can be a normal part of pregnancy.  However, if you experience severe or sudden swelling in your hands, face, feet and/or ankles, you should contact your health care provider as this could be a sign of pregnancy-induced hypertension (PIH).  Tips — Some women may have non-stress tests performed during the last weeks of pregnancy.  A fetal monitor will be attached to your abdomen and you will push a button every time you feel your baby move, and the monitor records your baby's heartbeat.  Plan — Your healthcare provider should discuss who to call when you think you are in labor and when the call should be made.

Week 39 (Dawamom_English_Dataset_Fixed): Baby development — Your baby is continuing to develop a layer of fat underneath the skin, which is an important part of your baby's ability to regulate body temperature.  Your baby is also beginning to form new skin cells to replace older skin cells.  Maternal changes — Effacement is the process by which the cervix prepares for giving birth.  The cervix will soften, shorten, and become thinner.  Early signs of labor include regular contractions, pelvic pressure, dull back pain, and a feeling of restlessness.  Tips — Even though you will deliver your baby soon, continue monitoring your baby's movements.  You may want to wait to take the tags off of gifts for your baby, in case items are not the right size or color.  Plan — At this point, you should really plan to take it easy.  Whether this is your first child or fourth, your life will not be the same once this new addition arrives.  So take some time for yourself, your partner, and your family.

Week 40 (Dawamom_English_Dataset_Fixed): Baby development — Your baby's bones have become hard, with the exception of the skull.  The bones in the skull need to remain soft and pliable so they can overlap as they pass through the birth canal.  Because of this, your baby's head may have a cone appearance for the first several days of life.  Maternal changes — When your baby's head remains visible through your vaginal opening and does not slip back in, it is known as crowning.  As your baby's head crowns, you will experience a burning or stinging sensation, often referred to as the 'ring of fire.'  As soon as you feel this, stop pushing to reduce your risk of tearing or needing an episiotomy.  Tips — Immediately after delivery, your baby will be given her/his first test, the APGAR.  It is a quick assessment of overall newborn well-being.  The scores are recorded at one minute and five minutes of life.  At five minutes, a score of seven to ten is normal.  Plan — During your last prenatal visit be prepared for tests like a Non-stress test and an Amniotic Fluid Index (AFI).  Your healthcare provider will discuss the possibility of going past your due date and potential induction.
